title: bruguiera × rhynchopetala
intro: Bruguiera × rhynchopetala, commonly known as the mangrove hybrid, is a plant species resulting from the cross-breeding of Bruguiera gymnorhiza and Rhizophora stylosa. It is a type of mangrove plant that is widely distributed in tropical and subtropical coastal regions. The plant has been found to have various health benefits, including antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which can help protect against infections and oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents present in Bruguiera × rhynchopetala include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other secondary metabolites that contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as anti-diarrheal and anti-ulcerogenic effects.
